name: Grouper
description: Groups dblog errors together into issues.
project_description:
Grouper - Drupal Log Analysis Made Simple
 "Drupal's built-in dblog viewer makes you consume the raw fire hose of data. Grouper lets you sip just the data you are looking for through a straw." 

 
 Back to top 

 The Problem 
 Your Drupal site's watchdog log contains thousands of entries. A single PHP error might appear 10,000 times—once for every page view that triggered it. Finding the actual problems buried in this noise is like finding needles in a haystack.

 Without Grouper: 

 
 10,000 log entries for the same error 
 200+ pages of scrolling 
 No way to see which errors matter most 
 Hours wasted on repetitive investigation 
 
 Back to top 

 The Solution 
 Grouper transforms your chaotic error log into an organized, actionable dashboard. Similar messages are automatically grouped into "Issues," ranked by frequency, so you instantly see what matters most.

 With Grouper: 

 
 10,000 identical errors → 1 Issue with count "10,000" 
 Instant visibility into your most critical problems 
 One-click drill-down to see when, where, and who 
 Minutes to identify and fix issues 
 
 Back to top 

 Key Features 
 📊 Smart Grouping 
 Grouper intelligently consolidates similar log messages. PHP errors are grouped by their actual error signature, not just the raw message text—so errors from different pages but the same root cause appear together.

 🔍 Multiple Analysis Views 
 
 
 
 View 
 What It Shows 
 
 
 
 
 PHP Summary 
 PHP errors grouped by issue, sorted by frequency 
 
 
 PHP Detail 
 All occurrences of a specific error with timestamps, URLs, IPs 
 
 
 Other Summary 
 Non-PHP messages (access denied, page not found, etc.) 
 
 
 Distribution 
 Breakdown of all log types with percentages 
 
 
 Severity 
 Errors organized by severity level 
 
 
 Module 
 PHP errors grouped by originating module 
 
 
 Pages 
 Which pages generate the most errors 
 
 
 People 
 Which users trigger the most errors 
 
 
 Host 
 Errors by IP address (find bad bots!) 
 
 
 
 🖥️ Command-Line Interface (NEW in 7.0) 
 Analyze logs without even opening a browser:

 # See top PHP errors
drush grouper:php-summary --limit=10

# Drill into a specific issue
drush grouper:php-detail 12345

# See all log types
drush grouper:types

# Filter by severity (errors only)
drush gps --severity=3
 Perfect for: 

 
 SSH-only server access 
 Automated monitoring scripts 
 CI/CD pipelines 
 Quick command-line troubleshooting 
 
 🤖 AI Integration (NEW in 7.0) 
 The Grouper MCP Tools submodule enables AI assistants like Claude to analyze your logs:

 You: "What are the main errors on my site?"

Claude: [Analyzes logs via MCP]
 "Your top issue is a TypeError in DateTimePlus.php
 occurring 10,100 times. It's affecting the /stories
 pages. Would you like me to show the details?"
 Requires: Tool API + MCP Server modules

 🏷️ Markers for Debugging 
 Create timestamped markers in your log to track changes:

 drush grouper:marker "Before module update"
# ... make changes ...
drush grouper:marker "After module update"
 Then filter your log view to see only what happened between markers.

 🧹 Log Maintenance 
 Selectively trim your log without losing everything:

 # Delete old entries (before wid 50000)
drush watchdog-trim-before 50000

# Delete entries in a range
drush watchdog-trim-range 10000 20000
 🚫 Message Filtering (Submodule) 
 The Grouper Message Filter submodule prevents specified messages from being logged at all—reducing database bloat from known, unfixable issues.
